spans.s: ? spuriti- (śraddhayā), Dbh.g. 〔56(82).17〕 (prose, not vs), (anena cittena, katham amī sattvā evam udāradharmasya) lābhinaḥ spuriti-śraddhayā satkṛtya śrāvayiṣyanti (sc. this treatise, Dbh) …; Rahder queries spṛhita-; I have thought of sphūrti-; neither is satisfactory; perhaps something like Skt. jhaṭ-iti, or BHS ṛg-(ṛṭ-, rig-)-iti, instantly (as separate word).
